tei:div.tei:p: 115) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal gyi rtsa dbang dngos grub snye ma bzhugs: 116) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: ( Dakini secret letter here) gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam mchog tu: las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag kun: sgo gsum smin byed dbang gi chu bo ni: rtsa dbang dngos grub gter gyi bum bzang bstan: gnas kyi sta gon rkyen bral dben pa'i sa: dam gtsang byin can nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i gnas: bsgrub gzhi dkyil 'khor la sogs spyi dang bstun: bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa'i rdzas rnams dang: bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams tshogs su bkod: rdo rje slob dpon lta dgongs dang ldan pas: dbang blang chas gsol slob ma khrus nas bton: bgegs bskrad gral du 'khod pa srung gur btsud: yid ches phyir du gter 'byung lo rgyus smos: de nas slob mas sgo gsum gcig dril gyis: dad pas me tog thal mo sbyar byas nas: bla ma lha la 117) gsol ba 'di ltar thob: kyai: rigs kun yongs 'dus bla ma rje: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: rdo rje theg pa'i lam mchog tu: 'jug phyir dbang gis smin par mdzod: ces lan gsum gsol: de nas slob dpon gyis: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: gsang sngags dbang la ma brten par: 'bras bu mchog gi sar mi slebs: sngon byon rgyal ba thams cad kyis: lam mchog 'di la brten nas kyang: 'bras bu rig 'dzin sar gshegs pas: khyed cag las dang skal bar ldan: lam 'dir 'jug par spro ba bskyed: dbang bzhi'i gdams pa bdag gis 118)stsal: dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung nus 'tshal: yang slob mas: kye ho: dbang ldan rgyal po bla ma dgongs: bdag cag rigs kyi bu mchog la: ci bsgo'i bka' las 'da' mi bya: dam tshig gnad rnams tshul bzhin bsrung: smin byed dbang gi bka' drin stsol: de nas slob dpon gyis: e ma e ma rigs kyi bu: dbang gis smin par byed pa la:

so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: sdom dang bslab pa dam tshig rnams: srog gi phyir yang 'da' mi bya: rim gnyis lam la brtson pa dang: dam bsrung dam las ma 'da' zhig: ces brjod: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba la: hoḥ rigs kyi bu khyod rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum du bzhugs par mos la: dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du rang gzhan rnams kyis skyabs kyi dam par 'dzin no snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: na mo: bla ma mchog gsum yongs 'dus dpal: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor la: sgo gsum dad pas skyabs su mchi: byang chub bar du bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum brjod: 119)de nas sems bskyed pa ni: 'o: 'di ltar nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i phyir bdag gis smon pa dang 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed par bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can kun: rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas sa thob phyir: smon dang 'jug pa byang chub sems: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: lan gsum brjod: de nas yan lag bdun pa ni: kyai: rigs kyi bu tshogs gsog pa'i sgo thams cad yan lag bdun par 'du ba yin pas de'i don dran bzhin: lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang: bla ma dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad pa'i drung du mchod pa 'bul ba dang: de dag gi spyan sngar nyams chags bshags pa dang: rnam par dkar ba'i dge tshogs bsags dang bsag 'gyur kun la rjes su yi rangs pa dang: rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol zhing: theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang: rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i dngos po thams cad la nye ring dang phyogs ris med par bsngos nas thams cad

120)'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags: dge tshogs rgya mtshor rjes yi rangs: theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskul: rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs: dge ba 'gro kun yongs la bsngo: bla med byang chub sa thob shog: lan gsum bskul: de nas yang: 'o: rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig: gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dbang dang: dbang gi srog dam tshig yin pas slob dpon gyi bkas bsgo ba bzhin dam tshig gi gnas rnams mi nyams par bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid dang: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: deng nas byang chub ma thob bar: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs mchog dang: yan lag dam tshig spyi bye brag: ma lus bdag gis bsrung nus kyi: mchog gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis: tshul bzhin 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: ces lan gsum gsol nas slob dpon gyis: ho: 'di ni phyag na rdo rje yi: byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam tshig chu: 121)dam bsrung dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: nyams na dmyal bar ltung ta re: de phyir dam tshig ma nyams srungs: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: de nas mig dar bkab pa ni: yang slob dpon gyis: ma rig pa'i sgrib pa bsal ba'i phyir mig dar bcings ba'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hāḥ yang slob dpon gyis: dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mjal ba'i phyir phyag rten du me tog gi chun po re 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐: de nas slob ma lhar gsal ba ni: las chu 'thor bzhin pas: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā sogs: haṃḥ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bdag mdun gsal snang sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus slob ma'i rgyud kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib gdos bcas kyi phung po dang bcas pa thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs:

stong pa'i ngang las: ma chags pad nyi bam gdan steng: slob ma skad cig dran rdzogs su: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar spyan dgu ldan: zhal 122)gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: ral pa dmar ser srid rtser 'khyil: thod skam dbu brgyan rtse bran mdzes: phyag drug g.yas gnyis gser rdo rje: rtse dgu dang ni rtse lnga bsnams: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: tha gnyis phur dbal 'og tu 'dril: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa dang: dur khrod chas kun ma lus rdzogs: zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs bdud bzhi mnan: ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i klong: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dpa' gzi ldan: rgyas 'debs khro mo sku la 'khril: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum du: spyi bor oṃ dkar mgrin pa ru: āḥdamar thugs kar hūm̐ mthing gsal: de las 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs kyi: sku gsum rgyal ba zhi dang khro: gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i zhing: dpa' bo ḍā ki dam can tshogs: ye shes phur pa'i rnam pa ru: spyan drangs slob ma'i sgo gsum dang: dbyer med ro gcig sa ma ya dza dza s+t+wam̐: de nas byin chen dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: log 'dren bdud bgegs 'dul mdzad he ru ka: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras 'khor bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang byin 123)dngos grub phobs: sgrub mchog sgo gsum dag rdzogs smin pa dang: snang rtog lha sngags chos nyid chen por rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod me tog 'thor bzhin: ye shes pa'i lha tshogs rnams slob ma'i sgo gsum la thim par gyur: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni: hoḥ bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon gyi: thugs las sprul pa'i gser thur gyis:

khyod nyid ma rig sgrib pa'i smag: bsal nas ye shes spyan du dbye: badz+ra dzñā na tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ de nas rig me dor ba ni: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: slob ma'i rig pa'i me tog 'di: sngon nas 'brel pa gang yod pa'i: lha der me tog babs pa ru: mchog gsum bden pas byin gyis rlobs: zhes brjod: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sid+dhi trām̐: lan gsum rjes su zlos: yang slob dpon gyis: 'o: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams khyed rang rnams kyi me tog dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs 124)gang du babs pa de ma brjed par yid la zungs shig: shar du babs na rdo rje'i rigs la dbang zhing zhi ba'i las 'grub: lhor babs na rgyas pa'i las 'grub cing rigs de la dbang: nub tu babs na pad+ma'i rigs la dbang zhing dbang gi las 'grub: byang du babs na las kyi rigs dang drag po'i las 'grub: mtshams bzhir babs na las mthun gyi dngos grub phran bu re thob pa dang: dbus su babs na las rab 'byams la dbang zhing 'bras bu mchog gi sar phyin no: me tog gang du babs pa'i phyogs de'i rigs dang nye ba'i lha gang bsgrub kyang 'grub sla zhing dngos grub kyang myur ba yin pas: 'di lta bu gzhan la gsang bar 'os pa yin pas shes par mdzod cig: lhag lha spyi bor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: pra ti ghṛ ha ṇa e maṃ: zhes brjod me tog mthor: de nas dngos gzhi'i lha dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni: kyai: dbang ldan rgyal po bla ma rje: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dngos gzhi'i dbang: yongs rdzogs gnang ba'i bka' drin stsol: ces dang: slob dpon gyis:e ma: skal ldan 125)las 'phro can: khyed rnams mos pa bzhin du dbang: yongs rdzogs dam pa bdag gis stsal: dam srungs dam las ma 'da' zhig: sa ma ya na ra kan: ces brjod dam chus dam la bzhag:

de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: brdal khyab spros bral bum pa ru: rang byung lhun grub dkyil 'khor rdzogs: thugs rje'i ye shes bdud rtsi 'khyil: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sku mchog 'gyur med dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las sku: gzung 'dzin bdud dang ru tra'i gshed: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru ka: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zung 'jug ye shes sku thob shog: rtsa sngags: a bhi sogs: de nas badz+ra kī la ya'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: badz+ra kī la'i dbang bskur ro: zhe sdang ma spangs rang grol nas: me long ye shes sku thob shog: rtsa sngags: badz+ra kī la a bhi sogs: de nas rat+na kī la ya'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= rat+na kī la'i= nga rgyal ma spangs= mnyam nyid ye shes= rtsa sngags: rat+na kī la ya a bhi sogs: de na 126)pad+ma kī la ya'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi= pad+ma kī la'i= 'dod chags ma spangs= sor rtogs ye shes= rtsa sngags: pad+ma kī la ya a bhi sogs: de nas karma kī la ya'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi= karma ki' la'i= phrag dog ma spangs= bya grub ye shes= rtsa sngags: karma kī la ya a bhi sogs: de nas steng phyogs khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi= dpal chen che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: hūm̐ kār yab yum dbang bskur ro: lha gdon zil gnon dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ a bhi sogs: de nas shar phyogs khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= dpal chen= rnam rgyal yab yum= dri za zil gnon= rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐ a bhi sogs: de nas shar lho khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= dpal chen=

dbyu+ug sngon yab yum= me lha zil gnon= rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ a bhi sogs: de nas lho phyogs khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= dpal chen= gshin rje yab yum= lho gdon 'dul ba'i dbang = rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ a bhi sogs: de nas lho nub khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: 127)skal ldan rigs= dpal chen= mi g.yo yab yum= srin po zil= rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐ a bhi sogs: de nas nub phyogs khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= dpal chen= rta mgrin yab yum= chu bdag zil= rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa hūm̐ a bhi sogs: de nas nub byang khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= dpal chen= 'dod rgyal yab yum= rlung lha zil= rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a pa ra tsi ta hūm̐ a bhi sogs: de nas byang phyogs khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= dpal chen= bdud 'khyil yab yum= gnod sbyin zil= rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ a bhi sogs: de la byang shar khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= dpal chen= khams gsum rnam rgyal yab yum= dbang ldan zil= rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ a bhi sogs: de nas 'og phyogs khro bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= dpal chen= stobs chen yab yum= sa bdag 'dul ba'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā bā la hūm̐ a bhi 128)ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas za gsod nyi shu'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: dpal che khro bcu yab yum gyi: ye shes sprul pa'i gar bsgyur ba: za byed gsod byed pho nya yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: hūm̐ bh+yoḥsarba a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas khra thabs nyer gcig gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi:

sku gsung thugs las sprul pa yi: sras mchog khra thabs nyer gcig gis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas sgo ma bzhi'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: tshad med thugs rje'i phrin las gar: ye shes sgo ma rnam bzhi yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas phur srung bcu gnyis kyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: dbyings kyi rje mo'i sprul pa mchog: zhing bcu 'dul phyir drag mo'i sku: phur srung bcu gnyis dbang bskur ro: ma mo'i srog la dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: ma ma dza bh+yo hring dza a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas skyes bu bzhi'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen phrin las sprul pa che: mngon spyod las kyi pho nya ba: skyes 129)bu chen po sde bzhi yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: rak+sha rak+sha ging ka ra tri badz+ra kro ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad kyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: sbyor yum sprul pa'i pho nya mo: log 'dren bdud bgegs 'dul mdzad ma: bka' sdod dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: ma tri ma bh+yo dza hring dza a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas dur khrod chas brgyad gtad la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byug pa'i rdzas dang bgo ba'i gos: spras pa'i rgyan chas 'di gtad pas: he ru ka dpal dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas phyag mtshan bzhi gtad la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang: me dpung rtse gsum 'di gtad pas: nyon mongs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas gzar blugs dang me hom gtad la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: gzar blugs me hom 'di gtad pas: las bzhi gang brtsams thogs med du:

'grub pa'i dbang 130)mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas thun mtshon sna tshogs thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: drag po'i thun mtshon 'di gtad pas: dgra bgegs ya ma dam sri'i tshogs: gsod gcod bsgral ba'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya= de nas thun zor thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi= drag po'i zor thun 'di gtad pas: 'phang ba tsam gyis dgra gdon bgegs: tshar gcod brlag nus dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya sogs: de nas ri rab bru khung gtad la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs= ri rab brub khung 'di gtad pas: ya ma dam sri dgra bgegs rnams: 'gugs bsgral mnan gzir dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya sogs: de nas bhan+dha bdud rtsi thogs la: hūm̐: phyi ni rang byung ka pā la: nang na ye shes bdud rtsi 'khyil: skal ldan bu la sbyin pa yis: gsung dbang yongs su rdzogs thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas snying po 'bru dgu gtad la: hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: gsung gsang 'dus pa'i snying po 'dis: skal ldan bu 131)la dbang bskur bas: lha dang rang snang dbyer med pa'i: chos nyid chen por dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas phreng ba gtad la: hūm̐: rin chen phreng ba brgya rtsa 'di: skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: bzlas pa sngags la dbang thob nas: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la: slob ma rnams kad cig gis dpal rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin cing spyan gsum sdang mig g.yo ba zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar gyi mche ba gtsigs pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing spyi bor rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa sku la dur khrod kyi chas thams cad rdzogs shing gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'khyil ba'i klong na zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs kyis pad nyi bam gyi gdan la bzhugs par bsgom la:

de nas rig tsaka gtad la: hūm̐: bde chen ye shes stong pa'i gzugs: shes rab mchog gi pho nya mo: bzhin mdzes 132)bcu drug lang tsho ldan: skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: dbab bzung bkram 'dren brtan thob nas: ma dag rlung lnga dbyings su 'jig: phyi nang gzhan gsum rnam dag cing: dag rdzogs smin gsum mthar son nas: 'bras bu sku dang ye shes dpal: mi slob lam gyi 'bras thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: ma hā su kha dzñā na pradzñā tsit+ta a bhi ṣi ñtsa hūm̐: de nas 'ja' shel gtad la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: mtshon byed brda yi dbang bskur bas: mtshon bya 'od gsal don rtogs nas: ka dag chos sku'i sa thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings brdal khyab gtor gzhong du: lhun grub rdzogs pa'i gtor ma bshams: rig rtsal ye shes gtor rgyan spras: dpal chen lha tshogs sgrub pa'i rten: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad la: dbang bsgyur dbang mchog thob pa dang: don gnyis lhun grub dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: ma hā bha liṃ ta maṇ+ḍa la sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ces brjod gtor ma gnas gsum du gtug: de nas mtha' brten gtad cing dam khas blangs: sku drin 133)gsob phyir sgo gsum bla mar 'bul: bkra shis me tog 'thor zhing rjes rim bya: las rjes mi mngon theg dman rigs la gsang: dbang 'di lan gcig thob pa'i skyes bu gang: rim gnyis lam 'jug tshe 'dir rig 'dzin thob: the tshom med do phyi rabs las 'phro can: sa ma ya: e ma shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa: mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig yang zab snyingapo 'di: dus gsum kun mkhyen rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku: dngos grub mchog brnyes pad+ma thod phreng la: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis gus btud de: phyi rabs rjes 'jug smin grol lam 'god phyir: dbang bzhi'i chu bo bdag la bstsal du gsol:

zhes gsol gser gyi maṇ+ḍal g.yu mtshom bkod: ga ṇa'i mchod pa 'byor tshogs yid 'ong dang: lus dbang ri rab gling bzhi'i tshul du phul: ma hā gu ru dgyes bzhin 'di skad rtsal: snod ldan ḍā ki ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: phyi rabs don du 'di ltar bskul ba legs: bid+yo ta ma'i bcud phyungs snying po 'di: a tsār+ya dang ḍā ki khyed la gdams: rang nyams longs la grub rtags thon bar mdzod: phyi rabs don du rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par smon: zhes gsungs gu ru'i thugs bcud gdams pa 'di: a tsār+ya yis yi ge'i ris su bkod: mdo khams 'bri rdzong mkha' 'gro'i gsang phug tu: seng ge gnam mchong brag gi mgul du sbas: 134)ma 'ongs las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas 'gro don dpag med 'byung bar shog: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer gyis shig: dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par srungs: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: brda thim: : ces pa'ang rten 'brel gyi brdas bskul tshe kun bzang chos nyid bde skyong dbang mos ser dgon dben gnas mtshams phrod 'od gsal ljongs nas nyams chos yig ris su bgyis pa'o// dge'o//
